gbm_population_evidence.quote: For Cohorts A and B, radiographic diagnosis of high-grade glioma that is then confirmed with biopsy.

candidate_evidence.quote: XRD-0394: Administered orally; small molecule dual inhibitor of ataxia telangiectasia mutated kinase (ATM) and DNA-PK.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: subjects with newly diagnosed and recurrent high grade gliomas receiving radiation therapy

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Maximum Concentration (Cmax) of XRD-0394 in Resected Tumor Tissue: Assessed among Pre-Surgical Dose-Escalation participants only.

role_evidence.quote: Concurrent XRD-0394 With Radiation Therapy for High Grade Gliomas

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral dual ATM and DNA-PK inhibitor (radiosensitiser)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: small molecule dual inhibitor of ataxia telangiectasia mutated kinase (ATM) and DNA-PK

source_quote.quote: MGMT-methylated patients will be enrolled in Cohort A following surgical resection.

coder_notes: Population is 'high-grade glioma' only; glioblastoma is not named anywhere in the record. Summary mentions radiation with or without concurrent temozolomide by MGMT status, but temozolomide is not a registered intervention and not given to every patient, so not listed as an agent. Cohort A = MGMT-methylated, Cohort B = MGMT-unmethylated (assignment by MGMT status, not linked to the candidate). Registered as EARLY_PHASE1 with allocation RANDOMIZED, but all arms are dose-escalation cohorts.
